# Fixtures whose frames trip the structural lint today. One stem per line.
# ADR-400's implementation empties this file.
#
# Three sources, in rough order of how many findings each accounts for:
#   - real edge defects: an arrowhead with no arm feeding it, a corner in a
#     horizontal run, an arm bleeding past an arrowhead
#   - arms running off the canvas edge in chart-style renderers
#   - ASCII ambiguity: '+' claims all four arms, and '.' and ':' are dotted
#     rules, so a corner or a period in a label reads as a dangling arm
